items.content_html:
｜Ting-Ying Lu・盧婷嫈｜

-

｜Artist Biography・藝術家簡介｜

With over three decades of experience in fashion design, publishing and creative work for luxury brands, she began working with ceramics in 2017. A turning point in 2019 led her to reconsider time, existence and the human condition. In 2022, she returned to university to study ceramics, wood carving and sculpture, while continuing her artistic practice alongside her studies.

Her practice centres on sculpture and extends across ceramics, wood and mixed media. Through the material qualities and transformations of different media, she explores how existence becomes perceptible and how time leaves traces upon things. Texture, weight, fragility and transformation become ways of considering how form can hold time, and how existence is perceived between what is visible and what is not.

具超過三十年時尚設計、出版與精品品牌創意經驗。2017年開始接觸陶藝，2019年的人生轉折促使其重新思考時間、存在與人的處境。2022年重返校園，系統性研究陶瓷、木雕與雕塑技術，目前持續大學學業與藝術創作。

創作以雕塑為核心，延伸至陶瓷、木材與複合媒材。透過不同材料的物質性與變化，探索存在如何被感知，以及時間如何在物件上留下痕跡；材料的質地、重量、脆弱性與變化，也成為思考形體如何承載時間，以及存在如何在可見與不可見之間被感知的方式。

-

｜Artist’s Statement・創作自述｜

My practice begins with a fundamental question: how do we know that something exists?

Existence and non-existence are not necessarily opposites; they may occur simultaneously through traces. Indentations, wear, cracks, distortions, remnants and absences are not merely material changes, but evidence of time passing. My work is therefore concerned not with how an object can be preserved intact, but with how it changes through time, and how existence becomes perceptible between what is visible and what is not.

I work through sculpture across ceramics, wood and mixed media, allowing the qualities and transformations of each material to become part of the inquiry. Through form, trace and space, I seek to give perceptible form to experiences that cannot otherwise be seen, allowing looking to move beyond the surface.

我的創作從一個基本問題出發：我們如何知道某件事存在？

「存在」與「不存在」並非彼此對立，而可能同時透過痕跡發生。凹陷、磨損、裂痕、變形、殘留與空缺，不只是物質的變化，也是時間經過的證據。作品因此關注的不是物件如何被完整保存，而是它如何在時間中改變，以及存在如何在可見與不可見之間被感知。

我以陶瓷、木材及複合媒材進行雕塑創作，讓材料本身的質地、重量、脆弱性與變化成為思考的一部分。透過形體、痕跡與空間，我試圖讓不可見的經驗獲得可被感知的形式，使觀看不再停留於表面。

-

items.title: Unyielding Will
items.summary: ｜Unyielding Will 頑強的意志力｜ This wheel-thrown Daruma holds a hidden bell that rings…
items.content_html:
｜Unyielding Will 頑強的意志力｜

This wheel-thrown Daruma holds a hidden bell that rings in an instant—like a prayer calling forth inner strength. The body shifts from ivory to a gradient of deep indigo and slate blue, reflecting emotional transitions during adversity. Gold leaf highlights the focused gaze, while a hand-painted mountain on the back symbolizes faith and willpower. Smoke firing crackles mark life’s trials, urging us to rise again from every sudden fall. 

這件手拉胚達摩，內藏鈴鐺，搖晃時在一瞬間響起的聲音，像喚神般喚醒內在的力量。作品由米白色起，逐漸轉為深藍至灰藍的青花漸層，象徵面對困境時心境的轉化與沉澱。達摩的雙眼周圍貼有金箔，散發堅定神采；背部手繪的青花山脈象徵堅持信念與不動如山的意志。煙燻燒結的細微裂紋，是生命歷練的痕跡，提醒我們：在任何一瞬的挫敗後，都要再站起來。

L25 x W25 x H30
Ceramic, gold leaf. Smoke firing. 陶瓷、金箔，煙燻燒成

items.title: Courage to accept
items.summary: ｜Courage to accept 坦然接受的勇氣｜ How can one keep moving forward with a…
items.content_html:
｜Courage to accept 坦然接受的勇氣｜

How can one keep moving forward with a smile, even when life leaves countless scars? The answer lies in the courage of acceptance. Like the polar bear, we must embody independence and resilience, trusting that even in harsh conditions, we can still live with ease. Every wound in life is both a lesson and a reminder, urging us to face and to accept. By believing that every crisis can turn into opportunity, and by giving our utmost effort, we free ourselves from regret, even in failure. These experiences become nourishment, shaping a graceful strength that allows us to rise lightly after each fall. For falling itself is never the problem—what matters is rising again with calm acceptance.

After all, in life, everything short of death is only a scratch.

如何在滿身傷痕的生活中，仍能微笑前行？關鍵在於「坦然接受的勇氣」。如同北極熊般獨立堅韌，在艱難環境中也相信能自在生存。生活的每道傷痕，都是學習與提醒，更是面對與接受的契機。唯有不斷說服自己：危機就是轉機，凡事竭盡全力，才能在失敗時無愧於心。這些歷練與積累，終將成為養分，使我們看似輕盈而優雅地活著。跌倒從不是問題，重點在於心境的坦然，能夠拍拍膝上的灰塵，再度站起，繼續前行。

畢竟生命除了死亡，一切都只是擦傷。

L190 x W 125 x H 290 mm 
Michelia compressa 烏心石

items.title: Moose, please help!
items.summary: Moose, please help! 駝鹿幫幫忙！｜2021 ｜Moose, please help! 駝鹿幫幫忙！｜ “Moose, please help!” is…
items.content_html:
｜Moose, please help! 駝鹿幫幫忙！｜

“Moose, please help!” is a ceramic sculpture born from personal limitation and symbolic longing. During a period of physical illness that kept me from walking, I yearned for the mountains—spaces of freedom and memory. I created this moose to hike for me, to carry a backpack and gather the mushrooms I love. With its sturdy legs, it walks the trail I can’t, fulfilling a wish I could no longer act on. This piece is not only about climbing; it’s about resilience, surrogacy, and tenderness in the face of constraint. It’s a quiet defiance—one footstep at a time.

「駝鹿幫幫忙」是一件融合個人體驗與象徵意義的陶瓷雕塑。創作期間，我正被身體的慢性病困住，難以行走或登山。山林，是我記憶中最自由的場域，香菇，是我童年與味覺的連結。於是我打造這隻駝鹿，背著登山包，緩緩走進山林，用牠的四肢代替我的腳，替我完成無法親身實踐的願望。它不只是攀登，而是在幫我重拾一段通往自然與內在的路。這件作品，是一場無聲的接力，也是對身體限制的一種溫柔對抗。

W 29 x D 20 x H 44 cm
Ceramic 陶瓷

items.title: ｜Situation：處境｜
items.summary: ｜Situation：處境｜ Solo exhibition ｜Main Concept｜ Situation: As Condition examines the states people…
items.content_html:
｜Situation：處境｜
   Solo exhibition

｜Main Concept｜

Situation: As Condition examines the states people inevitably confront throughout life, and the choices made within them.

Life is shaped by countless different “situations,” none of which offers a single right answer. Faced with the same circumstance, each person may make a different choice. We do not always fail to see; more often, we see, recognise, and then choose to overlook—sometimes by choice, sometimes because we have no other way.

The four works take the floor, wall, materiality, and emotion as carriers, beginning with subtle and persistent changes within everyday life. They examine the tensions between the visible and the invisible, the outer and the inner, awareness and neglect. Traces left unattended and emotions set aside do not disappear. Through neglect and delay, they continue to accumulate and quietly expand until they become impossible to avoid.

Seeing, therefore, is not simply an act of perception. It is a decision about what we see, what we acknowledge, and what we choose to leave unseen.

｜主要概念｜

關注人在人生中不得不面對的狀態，以及身處其中所做的選擇。

人生由無數不同的「處境」構成，而處境從來沒有唯一的正確答案。面對同一件事，每個人都可能做出不同的選擇。人並非總是沒有看見；更多時候，我們看見、察覺，然後選擇忽略——有時出於選擇，有時則因為不得不然。

四件作品以地面、牆面、物質與情緒為載體，從日常生活中那些細微而持續的變化出發，探討「可見」與「不可見」、「外在」與「內在」、「察覺」與「忽略」之間的張力。那些未被處理的痕跡與被擱置的情緒並不因此消失；它們在忽略與延遲之中持續累積，並安靜地擴張，直到成為無法迴避的存在。

因此，觀看不只是感知，而是決定我們看見什麼、承認什麼，以及選擇留下什麼不可見。

｜Turning a Blind Eye・視而不見｜

A subtle distortion appears on the floor, resembling faint irregularities in everyday life. It exists, yet remains barely visible; it is seen, yet easily ignored. Over time, turning a blind eye becomes a strategy—allowing one to live with others or oneself. Sometimes, turning a blind eye can be a choice—or simply a condition one must endure. One has to turn a blind eye to so much of oneself in order to get through life. 

地面出現細微變形，如同日常中不易察覺的異樣。它存在，卻不夠明顯；被看見，卻容易被忽略。視而不見有時是一種策略，使人得以與他人或自我共處；或是一種選擇；有時是一種不得不然的處境。有時，為了度過一生，人不得不對自身那麼多的東西視而不見。

16.5 Meter
Site-specific art 限地創作
Plastic, paint 塑膠布、漆

｜Unattended Signs・未被處理的跡象｜

Wallpaper slowly peeling away, its fragments falling like subtle traces of time. Nothing breaks dramatically; It simply happens within the ordinary. People pass by, pause, and rarely notice. The wall remains silent. Many fractures expand in this same quiet way. What is left unattended does not vanish—it accumulates through delay and neglect, eventually becoming something unavoidable.

牆紙緩慢剝落，碎片落在地面，像時間留下的微小痕跡。沒有戲劇化地破裂，只在日常中悄然發生。人們經過、停留，卻很少真正察覺。牆面依舊保持沉默。而許多裂縫正是在這樣的沉默裡擴大。那些未被處理的跡象，並不消失，而是在忽視與延遲之中持續累積，最終成為難以回避的現實。

Site-specific art 限地創作
Ceramic 陶瓷

｜Evidence in Tears・流動的證據｜

Beginning with a single tear, the work expands into multiple states of being. Scored ceramic surfaces record repetition and failure; gold leaf marks flashes of achievement; transparent glass suggests clarity after understanding—whether acceptance or release. Tears belong not only to sorrow but also to joy, success, injustice, and emotional impact. What appears as a visible single moment is formed through countless unseen accumulations.

由一滴眼淚延展為多重形式狀態。陶瓷上的刻痕記錄反覆嘗試與挫敗，金箔象徵成就的光芒，玻璃的清透則指向理解之後的瞬間清晰——無論是接納或放手。眼淚不僅來自悲傷，也源於喜悅、委屈與被觸動的時刻。那些被看見的瞬間，實則由無數未被察覺的情緒層層累積而成。

L115 x W65 x H 39 cm
Dimensions variable 尺寸可視場地調整
Resin, Ceramic, glass, gold leaf. 固化樹脂、陶瓷、玻璃、金箔

｜Beneath Appearances・表象之下｜ 

A seemingly formidable polar bear sits on a drifting ice floe. Its hard exterior contrasts with a soft interior that slowly emerges through cracks. It’s a simple but often overlooked idea: what we see is usually only the surface. When perception stops there, understanding can easily become distorted. What truly defines a person tends to remain unseen. Exterior and interior are not opposites; they simply require time to be understood.

看似強大的北極熊靜坐於浮冰之上，外殼堅硬，內部柔軟，並從裂縫中緩慢流出。這是簡單卻常被忽略的事：我們往往只看見表面。當理解停留於表面，就容易產生偏差與誤判。真正構成一個人的部分，往往隱藏在不被注意之處。外與內並非對立，只是需要時間去被看見。

L130 x W230 x H112
Dimensions variable 尺寸可視場地調整
Ceramic, found object. 陶瓷、現成物

items.title: Fearless
items.summary: ｜Fearless・無所畏懼｜ Life is about being fearless and moving forward—only then can we…
items.content_html:
｜Fearless・無所畏懼｜

Life is about being fearless and moving forward—only then can we see a different landscape.

With the head of a lion and the body of a dragon, the mythical creature rides the waves, symbolizing courage and unwavering will. Using self-made slip, white slip coating, and four layered glazes, the work captures the ever-changing form of the sea, distilling the strength and conviction to charge ahead without fear.

人生就是要無所畏懼，勇往直前，才能看見不一樣的風光！

獅首龍身，乘浪而行。奇獸躍於巨浪之巔，象徵無畏與堅定意志。以自製化妝土、粉引與四種釉藥交疊，雕塑變幻莫測的浪花，凝鍊出勇往直前的力量與信念。

W33 x D38 x H41 cm
Ceramic 陶瓷

items.title: Hare with straight flush
items.summary: ｜Hare with straight flush・握著同花順的野兔｜ A hare, dressed in a soft gray-blue hoodie,…
items.content_html:
｜Hare with straight flush・握著同花順的野兔｜

A hare, dressed in a soft gray-blue hoodie, sits cross-legged, quietly holding a set of a perfect royal flush. Yet the scene isn’t one of celebration, but of calm reflection. This piece speaks to a deeper truth: life isn’t defined by privilege or luck, but by how we use what we’re given. The hare becomes an allegory for clarity, choice, and quiet strength in the face of chance. It is a story of wisdom over circumstance.

野兔翹腳而坐，身穿淺灰藍帽T，右手持青花繪製的撲克牌，牌面是一副完美的同花順。這看似幸運的場景，卻不張揚勝利，反而透露一種冷靜與自省。作品寓意著——真正決定人生質地的，不是是否含著金湯匙出生，而是你是否懂得運用所擁有的一切，以智慧行動、沉著應對。這隻野兔，是每個在混亂中堅持思考的人，是一則關於命運與選擇的寓言。
